intent.summary: Scale local-first SQLite usage safely: optional dedup, faster write/query paths, reliability UX for storage failures, and backup/restore workflows.
intent.whyNow: Heavier use (frequent captures and large tables) increases write volume and query latency; users also need portable recovery via backup/restore without risking corruption.

decisions.title: Dedup baseline strategy
decisions.decision: Skip identical-to-last per (domain + url pattern + schema version) bucket behind a flag (default off).
decisions.rationale: Captures common repeated-capture cases with minimal schema complexity and clear guardrails.

commandsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "backup and restore keeps history and exports"
testsRun: npx playwright test tests/extension/sqlite-autocapture.spec.ts -g "backup and restore keeps history and exports"

evidence.notes: Unit tests pass; Playwright validates dedup skip behavior and backup/restore parity; baseline dedup performance artifact recorded.

followUps: Optional: add a stress/soak run in CI that writes large extractions and records query latency trends as artifacts.
